# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Gohery Properties are delighted to bring to the market this impressive ground floor 2 bed apartment in beautiful condition located in the very popular Gleann Mhuiris residential development. The apartment is ideally positioned close to the Claregalway and on the Galway side of the village. Close to schools, Lidl, Centra, hotels and Leisure centres and much more.

- Typ: apartment
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 68 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: 14 Gleann Mhuiris, Claregalway
